text:
incident-bot: INCIDENT OPEN — streaming mux path high latency and elevated 5xx rate. Spike started 2025-11-12T20:14:00Z. Affected region: us-west-2. Pager routed to oncall SREs. Runbook: https://playbooks.redwood/streaming-mitigation

Emma (SRE-oncall): I'm on it. Dashboards show mux-proxy CPU 95% and connection backlog queue > 12000. Streaming connections/sec spiked x3.

Raj (runtime): Can we toggle the realtime/chunked streaming flag to force long-poll fallback? That should reduce hotspotting on mux nodes quickly.

Emma (SRE-oncall): Plan: 1) Flip streaming flag OFF for hosted API -> pushes clients to full-response path. 2) Apply temporary rate limits for top-ten heavy API keys. 3) Keep dedicated customers and EU region unchanged for now. 4) Notify support + customers. Target mitigation window 30 minutes.

Liz (product-ops): Support team prepping template now. Will include expected impact and estimated restoration ETA. :white_check_mark:

Emma (SRE-oncall): Executing toggle now. Command I'm running:

curl -X POST https://ops.internal/flags/streaming_toggle -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED' -d '{"enabled":false,"reason":"mitigate mux CPU/latency spike"}'

deploy-bot: Flag update queued (change_id=8472). Propagation to edge nodes estimated ~30s.

Emma (SRE-oncall): Propagation observed. Active streaming conns dropping from ~18k -> 1.8k. mux-proxy CPU trending down to 62%.

Mike (eng-runtime): Also applied request shaping on the edge and lowered burst windows. Command used:

kubectl -n infra exec -it rate-limiter -- rlimit apply --namespace=hosting --rate=20r/s --burst=40

Raj (runtime): I've lowered per-key concurrent connections to 4 for the top-10 tenants via quota service.

support-bot: Created SUPPORT-INC-4021. Draft message:

{"subject":"Temporary change to streaming responses","body":"We're temporarily disabling streaming responses for hosted API to stabilize latency. You may see slightly higher tail latencies. We expect to re-enable within ~30 minutes. Contact support for urgent needs."}

Emma (SRE-oncall): Notes for incident log: capture sample request_ids that were downgraded so we can run regressions on output quality. Also tag metrics: mitigation.window=rolling-30m.

Liz (product-ops): I'll take monitoring handoff in 30 minutes and coordinate with support for any customer escalations.

Emma (SRE-oncall): If mux-proxy CPU sustains <70% for 15m we will pilot re-enable streaming for a small subset of traffic (non-critical tenants) and watch error/latency signals closely.

deploy-bot: Change 8472 propagated to 100% edges at 20:16:25Z.

Emma (SRE-oncall): Adding post-incident actions: 1) Improve prefix caching so fallback cost is lower 2) Pre-auth rate limiting improvements 3) Add test that simulates streaming hotspotting.

Emma (SRE-oncall): Closing mitigation thread; handoff to Liz for watch. Will reopen if metrics regress. /cc @support-team @platform-oncall
